request_accounting.cost_definition: Token-price estimates, not invoices. Each logical use pays its full receipt cost; physical shared receipts are counted once. Unknown cloud fees retain reservations. Local D3 GPU dollar cost is unpriced and null.

interpretation: All denominators use the frozen cohort. Pending/interrupted cases prevent a final comparison. Score/progress/steps means are explicitly completed-case summaries. Success-only steps are conditional. NetHack/NLE and Crafter use a custom maximum of 2000 model action decisions, with earlier native termination taking priority. A decision-cap ending is a complete time-limited evaluation, not a game win or the original paper full-horizon evaluation. Native engine horizons and native done/terminated/truncated/won metrics remain unchanged. H0 versus guidedH4 changes both history and goals, so does not isolate goal benefit.
latency_definition: Logical receipt latencies count every dependency at full independent-run latency; cached physical receipt time is not the observed wall time. Episode JSONL decision_wall_seconds records actual sequential execution/waiting.
